entry.title: Vintage Military Radio 1.0.16
entry.summary: Eight stereo tape-performance effects with polished chrome lever switches, black camouflage woven fabric, white effect labels, bright ON lamps and high-contrast amber Rotor Settings. Includes tape hiss, vinyl crackle, radio static, white/brown noise and 50/60 Hz mains hum. Owner reported v1.0.16 fully tested and working on MPC XL (Gen2), 2026-11-14. Gen1/Force hardware and device CPU benchmark remain untested. Downloads: - SDK-aarch64.zip: byte-identical owner-tested direct folder-copy ZIP, rena

entry.title: Vintage Military Radio 1.0.14
entry.summary: ## Current UI and sound textures Heavy polished chrome rotary switches (up = ON, down = OFF), enlarged effect circuits, removed title band, and five main sliders: Tape Noise, Vinyl Crackle, Radio Static, White Noise and Mix. SOUNDS adds large controls for all six noise sources, including Brown Noise and Mains Hum with 50/60 Hz selection. New layers default to zero and follow Mix/Mute/Bypass. ![Current interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vulnerablecodes/music-production/98bede711cbbf08f1
